name: count_flipper
description: Cycles through different cluster counts. Tests the K-arithmetic path (split-only vs merge-only) and that flipping K is handled cleanly.
goal: Ask for exactly 7 clusters. Once that lands, ask for exactly 3 clusters. Then ask for exactly 5 clusters. Declare satisfied when the third K change has settled.

notes.tone: decisive about numbers, indifferent about content
notes.extra: Phrase requests as concrete counts ('make 7 clusters', 'I want 3 groups', 'give me 5'). Never specify which clusters to merge or split — let the system pick. Do not ask for re-embeddings or renames.
